data_fields.name: zone.holdsHiddenInfo
data_fields.donor_constant: true for Hand and Library (and other deck/hand zones), false for Battlefield and Graveyard

data_fields.name: leaveArena.buffReset
data_fields.donor_constant: copy reset to original face on leaving the battlefield (no numeric value)

data_fields.name: move.replacementVerdicts
data_fields.donor_constant: NotReplaced/Updated proceed; Prevented stops; other results stop

best_idea: Route every move between zones through one function that captures the leaving entity's state first, runs a replacement pass, then removes, adds, fires the event and runs triggers last with the captured state.
decision_why: Take the single move path with LKI captured before removal and a replacement pass before the move, and the rule that a summon leaving the arena is removed; reject the Magic-specific branches and the whole-zone snapshot copy at each checkpoint (capture only the entity that moves).
acceptance: Server test: a fighter killed in the arena moves to out once, and its death trigger (loot roll, XP) reads hp and buffs as they were at death; a summon leaving the arena is removed and its id is in no zone afterwards.
